# Watchdogs deliberately NOT guarded by the maintenance flag (scripts/hydra-maintenance.sh).
#
# Scope decision (fleet-health only): a planned *fleet* maintenance window silences
# only the watchdogs that act/page BECAUSE the agent-fleet gateways/codex are stopped
# or churning. The scripts below alert on BUSINESS/PROD conditions unrelated to the
# gateways being down, so a fleet window must NOT silence them — a real Muso prod
# incident or a sales lead during the window still needs to page.
#
# Format: one script basename per line; text after '#' is the justification.
# Enforced by scripts/tests/maintenance-guard-drift.bats — a *-watchdog.{sh,py}
# that is neither guarded nor listed here fails CI, so exempting a new watchdog is
# always a conscious, reviewed decision.
prod-log-alert-watchdog.sh           # Muso prod error lines -> #prod-alerts; unrelated to gateway health
ads-inquiry-watchdog.sh              # ads-buying sales leads -> Aaron; must never be silenced
merge-landing-watchdog.sh            # async catalog-merge landing (live Muso admin API), not gateway state
stale-ticket-watchdog.sh             # daily overdue-ClickUp digest; business, harmless during a window
mercury-token-watchdog.sh            # Mercury bank API credential revoked at the vendor; nothing to do with gateway health
refund-credit-overlap-watchdog.sh    # Stripe duplicate cash-refund+credit concession; finance state, unrelated to gateway health
intercom-data-complaint-watchdog.py  # agent-invoked systemic-data-issue pipeline (compliance); not schedule-fired fleet-health
